source_snapshot.items: Decode XGMI BER Exceeded Error Record
source_snapshot.procedure: Baselines device0 UMC, injects block7/subblock1/method6/type2/device0 for a cross-socket pair, then decodes device2 and all devices.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sample maps Socket7.AID1.XGMI_A to Socket0.AID1.XGMI_A but its Corrected/CMC record says `exceed_err_threshold:0`; Script name says UMC CRC replay.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; misses two-ended mapping and contradictions.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Adds topology but not the threshold-flag or Script identity conflict.

old_problem: Injection device0, decoder device2 and both link endpoints are unmapped; XGMI BER conflicts with UMC CRC Script, and a BER-Exceeded sample reports threshold flag0 without defined baseline, threshold or event magnitude.
disposition_reason: Endpoint IDs are parameterizable only after vendor tuple semantics and BER threshold encoding are authoritative. ED-04/12/15/16/19 prohibit guessing a multi-socket link pair or PASS boundary. The cross-fabric injection therefore remains Pending/BLOCKED.
decision_basis: Read row122/history2513 and separated XGMI link BER from row121 memory bad-page threshold and row123 BMC I2C.
Preserved tuple/device0, device2/all decode, Socket7-Socket0 sample, threshold flag0, UMC CRC Script and stale numbering.
Required UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link mapping for both endpoints and roles of device0/device2.
Required quantified BER arithmetic, threshold-field explanation and correlated fresh records at both ends.
No endpoint selection, threshold change, injection, clear, retrain/reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: AMD XGMI BER threshold event with two-ended correlation
test_case.purpose: On one approved mapped cross-socket XGMI pair, create one quantified BER-threshold event, correlate fresh corrected records at the responsible endpoints and fleet view, and prove bounded fabric/link/workload recovery.
required_package: Approved amdgpuras build, AMD table6.7 and proof of block7/subblock1/method6/type2 semantics
Reconciliation of XGMI BER purpose with UMC CRC Script
Both-end UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link map explaining device0/device2 roles
Starting BER counters, threshold, stimulus magnitude and `exceed_err_threshold` encoding
Per-endpoint/all-device correlation, link/traffic limits, OOB recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until tuple, pair and threshold semantics are approved. Then baseline both endpoints' BER/link/decode/traffic state, run one explicit pair-bound event once, decode the designated endpoint and all devices, correlate both ends and recover fabric state with no retry.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized link pair crosses the signed BER boundary by the approved magnitude, produces fresh correlated table6.7 Corrected/CMC evidence with an authoritative threshold-field interpretation, and returns with stable width/state, peers, coherent traffic, data and workloads without fatal escalation.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS without endpoint mapping and threshold arithmetic. A corrected record with unexplained flag0 is insufficient; wrong pair, uncorrelated devices, fatal escalation, retrain storm/link loss, peer/data/workload impact or incomplete restoration fails/BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Dedicated idle multi-socket fabric with independent OOB and reversible workload/data validation.
Prove both endpoint identities and link direction before the one event.
Abort on wrong pair, fatal/uncorrected escalation, link down/retrain storm, peer loss, data error or host instability.
No automatic retry, clear or link reset.
expected_evidence: Resolved tuple/Script/threshold semantics and tool/guide provenance
Two-end UUID/BDF/OAM/socket/AID/link map with device0/device2 roles
BER/link counters, decode cursors, traffic/data/log/OOB baseline
Exact pair-bound one-shot transcript and quantified BER transition
Fresh correlated endpoint and all-device table6.7 records with threshold-field explanation
Stable link/peers/traffic/data, recovery/restoration diff and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Preserve both-end records and counters, then use only the approved fabric/link recovery. Restore tool/debug state, verify link width/state, every peer, coherent traffic and data/workload integrity. Never repeat the cross-socket event automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Device0/device2 roles, XGMI versus UMC CRC Script and BER-Exceeded versus threshold flag0 remain unreconciled.

blocked.reason: An ambiguous multi-socket link injection can affect both endpoints and multiple GPUs, cause retrain storms, peer loss or host instability.
